searchText: One thing we noticed with <@363800010518822915> is that if we sync without ever requesting by batch the Payloads we won't be verifying the Payloads signatures. We could verify them in batches later But honestly do we really even need to ever request Payloads by batch? A syncing client only needs the last envelope and sync over gossip. I honestly believe we will be safe removing all Payload RPC on the CL side And we can optimistically sync blocks on top of unknown Payloads immediately Instead of requesting them I'll raise this on ACD if there's one this week
